versions.subject: Disabling Security Tools
versions.detection:
keywords:
    - Command|contains:
      - 'service iptables stop'
      - 'chkconfig off iptables'
      - 'service ip6tables stop'
      - 'chkconfig off ip6tables'
    - CarbonBlack|contains:
      - 'service cbdaemon stop'
      - 'chkconfig off cbdaemon'
      - 'systemctl stop cbdaemon'
      - 'systemctl disable cbdaemon'
    - SELinux:
      - 'setenforce 0'
    - Crowdstrike|contains:
      - 'systemctl stop falcon-sensor.service'
      - 'systemctl disable falcon-sensor.service'
condition: keywords
versions.spl: Command IN ("*service iptables stop*", "*chkconfig off iptables*", "*service ip6tables stop*", "*chkconfig off ip6tables*") OR CarbonBlack IN ("*service cbdaemon stop*", "*chkconfig off cbdaemon*", "*systemctl stop cbdaemon*", "*systemctl disable cbdaemon*") OR SELinux="setenforce 0" OR Crowdstrike IN ("*systemctl stop falcon-sensor.service*", "*systemctl disable falcon-sensor.service*")
